approvals.reason: Pre-lock removal: with a single dark theme the light-theme logo slots can never display, so v2 no longer accepts them. The bundled admin web client drops the two fields in the same change; silo-apple and silo-android do not upload branding assets. The frozen v1 upload route still accepts the kinds.

Pre-lock removal: the web client has a single theme (Cinema Dark) and no community theme catalog, so the v2 catalog operations have no consumer. The bundled web client is updated in the same change; silo-apple and silo-android do not call the theme catalog. The frozen v1 catalog routes stay for the bridge.
